extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.title: Schematic of a fatigue fracture surface showing beach marks (Page 39)

extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.title: Macro-fractograph of a fatigue-failed threaded bolt inside a nut (Page 39)
extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.explanation: This macro-fractograph displays the characteristic cross-sectional fracture surface of a threaded fastener failure, featuring distinct labeled zones including the smooth fatigue propagation region and the rough final fracture region. extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.title: Macrograph of a railhead fatigue fracture showing beach marks (Page 40)
extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.explanation: This macro-fractograph displays the characteristic fatigue progression zone of a failed railway rail head. extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.title: Fracture surface of a rolling stock component with fatigue beach marks (Page 41)

extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.title: Fatigue Fracture Surface of a Rotating Shaft with Keyway Stress Concentration (Page 42)

extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.title: Fracture surface of rolling stock component showing fatigue beach marks (Page 43)

extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.title: Macrograph of torsional fatigue fracture surface inside a hub shaft (Page 44)

extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.title: Splined shaft torsional fatigue fracture showing radial ridges (Page 45)

extracted_figures\\Rolling stock FAILURE.title: Splined Shaft Failure Originating from Keyway via Reversed Torsion (Page 45)

extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: Macro-fracture surface of a threaded steel bolt showing fatigue zones (Page 1)

extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: Fracture surface of a forged connecting-rod showing fatigue failure (Page 2)

extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: Circular fatigue fracture surface showing smooth propagation and rapid final rupture zones (Page 2)
extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.explanation: This fractograph displays a classic rotating-beam fatigue failure in a circular cross-section, characterized by a smooth, concentrically rubbed fatigue crack growth zone surrounding an off-center origin and a coarse, radially striated final fast-fracture zone covering the remaining area.

extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: Fatigue fracture of an aircraft control link lug through a lubrication hole (Page 2)
extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.explanation: The diagram shows the original and improved designs of a fractured structural lug made of aluminum alloy 7075-T73. extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: Log-log S-N fatigue strength curve for UNS G41300 steel (Page 3)

It clearly distinguishes between low-cycle and high-cycle finite life regimes before leveling off at the endurance limit $S_e$ near $10^6$ cycles.

extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: Endurance Limit Versus Tensile Strength for Steels (Page 4)

The plotted experimental data points and boundary lines illustrate the empirical relationships defined by the piecewise equation for steel fatigue strength.

extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: S-N fatigue strength bands for wrought and cast aluminum alloys (Page 4)
extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.explanation: This log-log plot shows peak alternating bending stress versus fatigue life cycles for wrought, permanent mold cast, and sand cast aluminum alloys. It illustrates that nonferrous metals lack a true endurance limit, so fatigue strength is reported at a specified life such as $N = 5 \times 10^8$ cycles.

extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: S-N Fatigue Curve Modification Using Miner's Cumulative Damage Rule (Page 20)

extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: Macro-fracture surface of a threaded fastener showing fatigue beach marks (Page 2)

extracted_figures\\slides_failurefatigue.title: Stress Distribution and Fatigue Strength in Case-Hardened Components (Page 8)
